BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to child passenger restraint; amending RCW46.61.687; adding a new section to chapter 46.61 RCW; and providing aneffective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.61 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A person who has a current national certification as a childpassenger safety technician and who in good faith provides inspection,adjustment, or educational services regarding child passenger restraint p. 3 ESHB 1475systems is not liable for civil damages resulting from any act oromission in providing the services, other than acts or omissionsconstituting gross negligence or willful or wanton misconduct.
Section 1 of this act takes effect June 1,2007.
